title: GMS Week 46 - FREIGHT TAKES THE HELM
section_path: GMS Week 46 - FREIGHT TAKES THE HELM
section_path_text: GMS Week 46 - FREIGHT TAKES THE HELM
summary:
Main
Another week has passed without a meaningful change in global ship recycling conditions,although the trading market has strengthened its position once again. Dry freight has continued its recovery, crude oil has softened further and regional steel prices have offered some encouragement. Recycling indications remain unchanged across all four destinations, with healthy buying interest still frustrated by the persistent shortage of available candidates.
